infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SETU requires camera access to allow customers to show home repair defects to AI Ustad and upload work photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SETU uses your location to discover verified contractors and hardware stores within 15 minutes of your home.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SETU needs microphone access for voice search and live voice interaction with AI Ustad.

plugins.photosPermission: SETU requires access to your photos to upload project pictures and KYC documents.
plugins.cameraPermission: SETU requires camera access to scan defects and capture job photos.
